summary: The results return value appears when a task loops and contains a list of per-item module results, each with ansible_loop_var and item.
questions: How do I access each loop item's result in a registered variable?
What does results contain after a loop?

answer_card.title: results return value for loops
answer_card.answer_md:
For a looped task, the registered var has **`results`**: one result dict per item, each with `item`, `ansible_loop_var`, `changed`, `failed`, etc.

```yaml
- debug:
    msg: "{{ item.item }} changed={{ item.changed }}"
  loop: "{{ out.results }}"
```
